metadata.description: The GoCycling.ai plugin for Claude: cycling, gravel and MTB route planning on real OpenStreetMap data. Connect with a free GoCycling.ai account (https://gocycling.ai/claude).

plugins.name: gocycling
plugins.description: Plan cycling, gravel and MTB routes on real OpenStreetMap data. Turns a ride request into a route with distance and climbing figures, a GPX download, and a map link. Connect with a free GoCycling.ai account (setup guide: https://gocycling.ai/claude).
